info.name: Robarto Backend API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Robarto AI Omnichannel Management System backend. Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

**Auth:** Most endpoints require a Bearer Token in Authorization header.

**Roles:**
- `SYSTEM_OWNER` — Full platform access
- `BUSINESS_OWNER` — Manages own business
- `BRANCH_MANAGER` — Manages specific branch

item.name: 🌐 Public APIs (AI Agent Use)
item.description: These endpoints require the X-Agent-Token or similar public API token header instead of Bearer JWT.
